err.peer_outdated: The other device runs an older Pulsar. Update it to connect with a password.
err.portInUse: Port is in use — pick a different one in Settings → Network, or leave it empty
err.relayResolve: Could not resolve the relay server
host.encodeFailed: Video encoder failed to start — no encoder worked; tried
host.captureNoFrames: Can't capture the screen: the host gets no picture from its graphics card. Try restarting Pulsar on the host.
err.identityChanged: The identity behind this device has changed. Accept the new identity and reconnect?
err.localRelayBind: Could not start the in-app relay (the port may be in use)
update.inProgress: Pulsar is being updated. It will open by itself once the install finishes — give it a few seconds.
ds5.shed.speaker: Weak Bluetooth: controller speaker turned off
ds5.shed.mic: Weak Bluetooth: controller mic turned off
ds5.shed.haptics: Weak Bluetooth: HD haptics turned off, using classic rumble

ds5.restore.mic: Bluetooth recovered: controller mic back on
ds5.restore.haptics: Bluetooth recovered: HD haptics back on
ds5.shed.headset: Weak Bluetooth: audio to the controller headset jack stopped
ds5.restore.headset: Bluetooth recovered: audio back on the controller headset jack
ds5.headset.off: Headphones unplugged: audio plays on this device again
hint.wifi24: Wi-Fi is on 2.4 GHz: latency may rise and a Bluetooth controller suffers. Use a 5/6 GHz network if you can
